caption: The drawing shows a rectangular wooden box with a hinged lid. The box is depicted in perspective, showing the front and right side. The wood appears as various shades of brown, with the lid and base having darker brown trim. On the front panel, there is a dark brown silhouette of a horse running on a light brown ground or base. To the left and right of the horse, there are two circular, pinwheel-like decorations composed of alternating light and dark brown triangular segments. Vertical rows of diamond and triangular shapes in yellow, orange, and brown run along the left and right edges of the front panel, framing the horse and circular designs. On the right side of the box, there is a single flower-like motif with five petals in lighter brown and yellow tones. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white.
title: Strong Box
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
